stem: Which key idea about the people of the West is important to BOTH the article “Pictures of a Disappearing Past” and the poem “Out Where the West Begins”?

options.label: A
options.text: The beauty of the West matters to the people who live there.

options.label: B
options.text: The communities of the West have very friendly people.

options.label: C
options.text: The West began to change for the people who lived there.

options.label: D
options.text: The West has been home to many interesting people.
